# DopaBrain

> Evidence-based psychological self-assessments, cognitive training coaches, and emotional wellness tools available in 12 languages. Instant, private, client-side, with zero mandatory signup.

DopaBrain (https://dopabrain.com) is an interactive mental health, cognitive fitness, and self-discovery platform. It supports 12 languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Russian, Hindi, Indonesian, and Turkish. All assessments operate entirely client-side, ensuring user privacy and confidentiality.

## Core Psychological & Cognitive Tools

- [Stress Check](https://dopabrain.com/stress-check/): Perceived stress assessment grounded in Cohen's Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-10) measuring physical, emotional, and cognitive stress dimensions with tailored recovery protocols.
- [Stress Decompression Plan](https://dopabrain.com/stress-check/plan.html): Personalized multi-tier recovery plans based on perceived stress severity.
- [Stress Boundary Script Builder](https://dopabrain.com/stress-check/script.html): Assertive communication scripts and professional boundary-setting templates.
- [Stress Relief Library](https://dopabrain.com/stress-check/library.html): Somatic decompression exercises, physiological sigh guides, and guided progressive muscle relaxation.
- [HSP Sensitivity Test](https://dopabrain.com/hsp-test/): Highly Sensitive Person self-assessment based on Dr. Elaine Aron's Sensory Processing Sensitivity (SPS) DOES model (Depth of processing, Overstimulation, Emotional reactivity, Sensing the subtle).
- [HSP Sensory Reset](https://dopabrain.com/hsp-test/reset.html): Low-stimulation sensory regulation protocol designed for quick recovery from sensory overload.
- [Future Self Continuity](https://dopabrain.com/future-self/): Longitudinal self-continuity simulation and temporal discounting exercise based on Dr. Hal Hershfield's behavioral psychology framework.
- [Dilemma Decision Matrix](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/decision-matrix.html): Interactive weighted decision matrix based on the Pugh Decision Matrix method (Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis) for resolving dilemmas, breaking analysis paralysis, and comparing competing choices across weighted dimensions.
- [Burnout vs Stress Differential Matrix](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/burnout-stress-differential.html): Dual-axis 2D quadrant assessment distinguishing acute autonomic tension (PSS-10) from systemic occupational exhaustion (MBI), with localized tactical decompression protocols.
- [Emotion Regulation Planner](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/emotion-regulation-planner.html): Practical 5-stage emotional regulation action planner grounded in Dr. James Gross's Process Model of Emotion Regulation (Situation Selection, Modification, Attentional Deployment, Cognitive Change, Response Modulation).
- [2048 Strategy Coach](https://dopabrain.com/puzzle-2048/coach.html): Interactive tactical trainer teaching corner-locking, monotonic snake builds, and blunder-recovery techniques for mathematical tile puzzles.
- [Brain Type Quiz](https://dopabrain.com/brain-type/): Five-dimensional cognitive profile evaluating analytical, creative, strategic, intuitive, and empathetic thinking styles.
- [IQ & Abstract Reasoning Test](https://dopabrain.com/iq-test/): Progressive matrix reasoning assessment (Raven SPM methodology) measuring fluid intelligence and non-verbal pattern deduction.

## Self-Discovery & Personality Assessments

- [Dark Core Test](https://dopabrain.com/dark-core/): Assessment of the Dark Factor of Personality (D-factor, Moshagen et al.) measuring Machiavellianism, narcissism, and moral disengagement.
- [Emotional Age Assessment](https://dopabrain.com/emotional-age/): Psychometric evaluation of emotional regulation, self-soothing, and social maturity.
- [Love Language Test](https://dopabrain.com/love-language/): Discover primary relationship communication channels across Chapman's 5 Love Languages.
- [Red / Green Flag Relationship Test](https://dopabrain.com/red-green-flag/): Self-audit tool measuring relationship boundaries, mutual respect, and emotional safety.
- [Animal Personality Test](https://dopabrain.com/animal-personality/): Behavioral archetype profiling tool analyzing conflict resolution and workplace communication styles.
- [Toxic Trait Self-Audit](https://dopabrain.com/toxic-trait/): Introspective tool for identifying defensive habits, avoidance triggers, and emotional coping mechanisms.
- [K-POP Role Roster](https://dopabrain.com/kpop-position/): Team role and group dynamics profile based on creative expression, performance focus, and communication styles.
- [Burnout Risk Screener](https://dopabrain.com/burnout-test/): Occupational burnout assessment measuring emotional exhaustion, depersonalization, and personal achievement.
- [Cognitive Distortions Identifier](https://dopabrain.com/cognitive-distortions/): CBT-based cognitive distortion finder identifying catastrophizing, mind-reading, and dichotomous thinking.
- [Emotion Iceberg Explorer](https://dopabrain.com/emotion-iceberg/): Emotional granularity tool identifying primary root feelings underneath secondary reactions.
- [Attachment Style Test](https://dopabrain.com/attachment-style/): Relationship attachment assessment based on Bowlby & Ainsworth attachment theory (secure, anxious, avoidant, disorganized).
- [MBTI Love Compatibility](https://dopabrain.com/mbti-love/): Romantic synergy and communication dynamics analysis based on MBTI personality archetypes.

## Wellness Utilities & Brain Games

- [Digital Detox Timer](https://dopabrain.com/detox-timer/): Focus timer with soothing ambient soundscapes and usage accountability.
- [Daily Tarot & Reflection](https://dopabrain.com/daily-tarot/): Archetypal card reflection for mindful introspection and journaling prompts.
- [Dream Fortune & Symbolism](https://dopabrain.com/dream-fortune/): Symbolic dream analysis and subconscious emotional reflection.
- [Puzzle 2048](https://dopabrain.com/puzzle-2048/): Browser-based sliding tile puzzle.
